scientific_integrity: Claims are proved analytically. Finite checks are reproducibility tests, not certificates for unbounded parameter families. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: One planar outlier with equal sample weights; all-phase, large-sample sharp endpoint norm and every maximizing radius, with exact finite-sample outlier-row formula. No global finite-size radius uniqueness, stochastic variance bound, or general outlier-cloud claim.
title: Sharp leverage amplification from one outlier in circular affine least squares
